contentText: In an interview with FRANCE 24, Democratic Congresswoman Pramila Jayapal laid out her priorities for the new Congress: ending the war in Iran, tackling the cost-of-living crisis, curbing political corruption and holding the Trump administration accountable for its immigration crackdown. She also called for the "complete" dismantling of the US federal immigration agency ICE and backed an end to US military funding for Israel.
